# Olipop prepares for growth with new CEO

olipop.jpg

Ben Goodwin, left, is transitioning from founder and chief executive officer of Olipop to chairman and head of innovation. Christian Patiño Webb has been named the company’s new CEO. | Photo: Olipop

By Brooke Just

[Google Add as a preferred source on Google](https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=foodbusinessnews.net&location=article_header)

OAKLAND, CALIF. — Functional soda company Olipop has named Christian Patiño Webb as its new chief executive officer to support its next stage of growth.

Patiño Webb succeeds Ben Goodwin, founder and CEO, who is transitioning to executive chairman and head of innovation for the company.
Goodwin, who founded the company in 2018 to support digestive health, will focus on the company’s long-term vision, advance innovation and also shape its next phase of growth while also stewarding its mission, values and culture and will work in partnership with Patiño Webb.

Patiño Webb comes to Olipop from Electrolit, where he most recently was CEO.

During his career, Patiño Webb also has worked for Procter & Gamble, Johnson & Johnson, Red Bull and Unilever.

“Founding and leading Olipop to mainstream success has been the honor of my lifetime, and I feel extremely fortunate and proud of what we’ve accomplished to date," Goodwin said. “The team and I spent significant time carefully selecting a CEO and Christian unequivocally rose to the top. His clear track record of scaling consumer brands that have a focus on product quality and are driven by a strong founder vision make him a fantastic fit for the next leg of our journey.

It has been featured in the Times100s Most Influential Companies in 2024 and it is now in one in five households in the US.

In a Linkedin announcement the company said that Olipop continues to grow in “scale, complexity, and reach” with the appointment of Webb, who has previously worked at Unilever and most recently for Electrolit, the hydration beverage brand, as CEO “marking an important moment in this evolution.”

He will oversee business operations, distribution, organisational execution, brand expansion, and strategic growth initiatives.

Goodwin will continue to shape the long-term vision of the company by driving breakthrough innovation.

“Working in close partnership, Ben will help guide business strategy, ensuring the company continues to build on the vision that created the functional soda category, while Christian brings the leadership expertise needed to expand its impact on consumers,” the statement said.
Goodwin said on Linkedin that he wants to focus his energy where he has the most passion and can contribute “most meaningfully.”

He described the move of bringing in a CEO as “adding horsepower rather than simply reallocating focus.”

He added: “Given all that, I decided it was time to explore bringing in a new CEO - someone who could be a powerhouse operator and help drive the business in a mission-aligned way, while allowing me to double down on innovation, research, culture, marketing, thought leadership, and strategy.”

Webb also commenting on Linkedin said: “What Ben Goodwin and the entire Olipop PBC team have built is extremely special. They created a category that has changed the way people think about soda while staying deeply committed to their mission, their consumers, and the values that have guided the company from the beginning.
“My focus will be on scaling the business for the future, investing in our people and capabilities, strengthening execution, and building on the strong foundation already in place. Most importantly, I’ll be listening, learning, and working alongside this exceptional team as we continue to expand OLIPOP’s impact on consumer health at scale.”

Olipop appoints former Electrolit CEO Christian Patiño Webb as chief executive

Olipop has appointed former Electrolit CEO Christian Patiño Webb as its new chief executive officer, as the functional soda brand strengthens its leadership team to support its next phase of growth.

Christian Patiño Webb
Christian Patiño Webb

Webb joins Olipop after leading hydration beverage brand Electrolit from 2022 to 2026. Before that, he served as vice president of marketing for Unilever-owned supplements brand SmartyPants Vitamins between 2020 and 2022. He has also held several senior roles at Red Bull from 2013 to 2018.

In his new position, Patiño Webb will oversee Olipop’s operations, distribution, organisational execution, brand expansion and strategic growth initiatives.

Olipop said his experience in scaling high-growth consumer brands and building the operational infrastructure needed by expanding founder-led businesses would help advance the company’s long-term strategy.

The appointment forms part of a wider leadership restructuring at Olipop. Founder Ben Goodwin will transition into the roles of executive chairman and head of innovation, where he will continue to guide the company’s long-term vision, business strategy and product development.
Goodwin and Webb will work closely together, with Goodwin focusing on innovation and the company’s founder-led vision while Webb leads its operational growth and expansion.

Olipop said the new structure would provide additional operational expertise as the business grows in scale, complexity and reach, while preserving the mission and culture that have shaped the company since its launch.
